limitations: One accepted20s sample per scenario per build; about0.5988% p95 increase, within5% for these observations only. No repeated-trial confidence interval or release qualification.
Stationary active-play is background simulation/rendering, not sustained active-input play.
Real first wins use the same public settings and input protocol but different routes, enemy locations, score and duration; this is not identical-replay timing.
Frame intervals include observer and browser scheduling overhead. Page-wide long tasks from arming through completion do not attribute reward work or establish its50ms target.
Connected resources and approximate heap do not measure detached owners, unreleased object URLs, retained decoder allocations or total edition-owned memory.
Current candidate was locally compiled twice; this does not prove downloaded/deployed current release bytes or PWA installation behaviour.
